decision: Pooled shared coefficients are not invariant to per-birth arbitrary PCA signs. Require common basis or per-birth invariant statistic before interpreting data. This does not assert the magnitude of bias on actual fly data. No worker branch changed.
reproduction: x=default_rng(125).normal(size=(600,2)); y=x[:,0]; compare LagFit([x,x],0,0).r2([y,y]) with LagFit([x,-x],0,0).r2([y,y])
